name: Cream Scones
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Mix and sift together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
Rub in butter with tips of fingers; add eggs well beaten, and cream.
Toss on a floured board, pat, and roll to three-fourths inch in thickness.
Cut in squares, brush with white of egg, sprinkle with sugar, and bake in a hot oven fifteen minutes.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
